video.description: The clip (any format AVFoundation reads: mp4, mov, m4v). Give video, frames or image.

frames.description: Instead of a video: the clip as image files in time order (1-64).

image.description: Instead of a video: one picture, embedded as a still clip of num_frames copies (the card's image example).

num_frames.description: Frames taken from the video, evenly spaced over the clip or the start-end window (an odd count gets its last frame repeated); also the copies of an image. The card samples 64 frames for this model; fewer is lighter.

start.description: Start of the window in the video, in seconds.

end.description: End of the window in the video, in seconds (default: the end of the clip).

per_step.description: Also return one embedding per pair of frames (the model's time step).
